title: Physiological Changes During Pregnancy: High-Yield Quiz

questions.q: Where does fertilization normally take place?

options.e: Wrong. The isthmus is the narrow part near the uterus.
Wrong. Implantation, not fertilization, occurs there.
Wrong. The funnel-shaped opening near the ovary.
Correct. Fertilization occurs in the ampulla.

questions.q: Which hormone drives decidualization of the endometrium, and from which source?

options.e: Wrong. Estrogen is not the driver stated.
Wrong. hCG rescues the corpus luteum.

questions.q: Which cell layer of the placental barrier is made by the fetus and lines the villi?

options.e: Wrong. Maternal side of the placenta.
Correct. It forms the thin outer layer of the barrier.

questions.q: Which layers form the placental barrier at term?

options.t: Chorionic plate, basal plate and myometrium

options.e: Wrong. Membranes, not the exchange barrier.

options.t: Fetal capillary endothelium, basal lamina and a thin syncytiotrophoblast
options.e: Correct. A barrier 5 micrometres or less.

questions.q: What gives the placenta its large surface area?

options.e: Wrong. The blood-filled space between villi.

questions.q: What does hCG do to the corpus luteum?

options.t: Rescues it from degeneration until the 3rd-4th month
options.e: Correct. The corpus luteum keeps secreting progesterone and estrogen.

questions.q: Which placental hormone increases pubic symphysis flexibility and helps dilate the cervix?

options.e: Wrong. Acts on metabolism and breast.
Wrong. Prepares the body for birth in general.

questions.q: Which hormone decreases glucose use and increases fatty acid use for ATP production?

options.e: Correct. Spares glucose for the fetus.

questions.q: Which fetal precursor does the placenta convert to estrogen?

options.e: Wrong. The placenta makes it from cholesterol.

options.t: DHEA from the fetal adrenal cortex

questions.q: By what mechanism does the uterus enlarge during pregnancy?

options.e: Correct. Volume rises from a few mL to 5-7 L.

questions.q: When does the corpus luteum enlarge during pregnancy?
Which pairing of skin change and name is correct?

options.t: Pigmentation: stria gravidarum; linear scars: cloasma
Pigmentation: cloasma; linear scars: stria gravidarum

options.e: Wrong. Linea alba is a pigmented line.

questions.q: By how much does blood volume rise in pregnancy?

options.e: Correct. Cardiac output rises and SVR falls.

questions.q: Which respiratory change is correct in pregnancy?

options.e: Correct. Enhances O2 delivery to the fetus.

questions.q: By how much does GFR increase in pregnancy?
Which hematologic state occurs in pregnancy?

options.t: Hypercoagulable, with increased clotting factors and decreased fibrinolysis

questions.q: Which placental hormone enters the fetal circulation to start the onset of labor?

options.e: Correct. It raises fetal ACTH and cortisol.
Wrong. Acts on symphysis and cervix.

questions.q: What do increased estrogen levels do to the myometrium near labor?

options.t: Fewer gap junctions and more progesterone
More gap junctions, oxytocin receptors and prostaglandins
options.e: Correct. The uterus contracts as a unit.

questions.q: What is the correct duration of stage 1 of labor and its description?

options.e: Correct. Stage 1 ends with full dilation.

questions.q: Which hormone maintains the endometrium and helps prepare mammary glands for lactation after the corpus luteum is rescued?

options.e: Wrong. Acts on symphysis and cervix.
Wrong. Acts on mammary growth and metabolism.
Correct. Also prepare the mother's body for birth.
